# Apify Affiliate program

Earn by spreading the word about the largest marketplace of trusted tools for AI. A program that rewards real collaboration, with up to 30% commission, up to $5,000 per customer, and a focus on long-term value.

## Word from Apify partners

Join 5k+ affiliates earning recurring commissions by recommending Apify.

## Three partner tiers

### Starter

0-49 active customers

### Performer

50+ active customers

### Elite

Agreed individually

20% commission for the first three months, then 30% afterward, up to $2,500 per customer.

Let's discuss custom terms.

## Statistics

Real numbers from a growing partner program.

### 15%

### 250+

AI tools and automations

## Benefits

Everything you need to grow with Apify, from flexible rewards to partner support and reliable monthly payouts.

### Unlimited free trial

A $5 free trial renews monthly, giving referrals time to try Apify before subscribing, for better conversion.

![](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn-cms.apify.com%2F1_a7dbf9e433.webp&w=3840&q=75)

### Perks beyond payouts

As a top performer, you and your referrals get exclusive discounts, free prepaid usage, and early access.

![](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn-cms.apify.com%2F2_9695455015.webp&w=3840&q=75)

### Visibility and community

Collaborate on co-marketing campaigns, workshops, partner stories, and industry events for lasting partnerships.

![](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn-cms.apify.com%2F3_587b2724e5.webp&w=3840&q=75)

### No time limits on commissions

Get 20% commission on every customer you refer during their first three months, then 30% after that.

![](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn-cms.apify.com%2F4_2eb3b8f836.webp&w=3840&q=75)

### Easy payouts, every month

Get paid securely through Wise, PayPal, or bank transfer.

![](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn-cms.apify.com%2F5_9d97713960.webp&w=3840&q=75)

## Frequently asked questions

To qualify for a payout, you need at least three referred customers and $100 in earnings. Once you hit both, your earnings transfer to your Wise, PayPal, or bank account listed in the affiliate dashboard. Payouts can't be processed until you add a preferred payment method, so set that up first. You can also exchange your earnings for Apify platform usage and get 15% more: $100 in commissions becomes $115 in prepaid usage.

Your tier is based on how many active customers you've referred, and it determines how much each one can earn you.

**Starter** (0 to 49 active customers): up to $2,500 per customer **Performer ** (50 or more): up to $5,000 per customer **Elite:** admitted individually, with commission rate and cap set in a separate agreement

There's no time limit: if a customer takes months or years to reach the cap, you'll keep earning commission the whole time.
